question: Choose the antonym of ‘imitate’:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Innovate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Imitate"** means to copy or follow someone or something, especially by emulating their behavior, style, or actions. (नकल करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He tried to imitate his favorite actor's mannerisms while acting in the school play.
 
 
 
• **"Innovate"** refers to creating or introducing something new, especially by inventing original ideas or methods. It is the opposite of imitating as it involves creativity and originality. (नवाचार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company aims to innovate by designing cutting-edge technology products.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'imitate'** is **'innovate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Innovate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Replicate** (प्रतिलिपि बनाना): To make an exact copy of something.

 
 
• **Example:** Scientists are working to replicate the results of the experiment in controlled conditions.
 
 
 
• **Copy** (नकल करना): To reproduce or imitate something exactly.
 
 
• **Example:** He copied the answers from his friend's notebook during the test.
 
 
 
• **Echo** (गूंजना): To repeat or mimic a sound or statement.
 
 
• **Example:** Her words seemed to echo in the empty hallway.
